observations: Black DSLR camera body with 'Canon' branding on the flash housing.
Model badge 'EOS 800D' is visible on the front-right of the body.
Lens is attached with a 'Canon' branded lens cap.
Lens barrel markings indicate an 'EFS 18-55mm' focal range.
The camera has an articulated rear screen, shown in the closed position.
The lens features a 'STABILIZER ON OFF' switch.
Photos appear to be taken in a retail environment with other camera boxes (EOS 4000D, Nikon D7000) visible in the background.
A watermark 'KJ-TECH' is present on the images.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 2 show the model name and lens focal length.
No screenshot of a shutter count diagnostic tool is provided.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: The lens cap is on in all photos, obscuring the glass elements.
These accessories are not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, focusing, and successfully taking a photo.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be significantly higher than claimed, affecting longevity.
risks.proof: A screenshot from a shutter count utility (e.g., EOSCard or ShutterCount) showing the serial number and count.

risks.risk: The lens glass may have internal fungus or surface scratches that affect image quality.
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements without the cap.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched or have permanent dust/spots.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or a test shot of a white wall at a high aperture (f/22).

risks.risk: Battery and charger may be missing or low-quality third-party replacements.
risks.proof: A photo showing the labels on the battery and the charger.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Screenshot of the shutter count software readout.
Photos of the front and rear lens glass without the cap.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon 800D with a kit lens. Because functionality and condition are unproven, it is priced at the worst case using the lowest available DSLR comparables.
